title: Kac-Vinberg Grading at an Epipelagic Point
body_html:
Kac-Vinberg Grading at an Epipelagic Point

At an epipelagic point \(x\) of order \(m\), choose a tame splitting extension and move \(x\) to a hyperspecial base point \(x_0\). The Galois generator and the translation element define an automorphism \(\theta\) of the reductive quotient \(\mathbf g^\circ\).

The Moy-Prasad graded piece at depth \(-1/m\) is identified with a \(\zeta\)-eigenspace \[ (\mathbf g^\circ)_{\theta,\zeta}. \] Stable vectors for the reductive quotient action on this Moy-Prasad piece correspond to stable vectors in the Kac-Vinberg graded Lie algebra.
proof_html: The proof constructs the translation element \(t\), compares the Galois action before and after conjugation by \(t\), and uses multiplication by the chosen uniformizer to identify the depth-graded lattice quotient with the eigenspace of \(\theta\).
